dependencyRationale: Reminder delivery crosses persisted settings and backup codecs, SQLDelight-backed product snapshots, platform-neutral reconciliation, Android alarm/permission hosts, iOS notification hosts, Compose production assembly, localized resources and host lifecycle entry points.
fallbackReason: The production reminder graph has transitive inputs across every shared module and both native hosts; a repository-wide immutable scope avoids omitting action/domain, resources, native configuration or generated database inputs while concurrent assignments are serialized by exact allowed-file ownership.
toolchainIdentity: Gradle wrapper 9.5.1; JDK 17; Kotlin 2.4.10; AGP 9.1.1; Compose Multiplatform; SQLDelight 2.4.0; Android API 23-37; iOS arm64/simulator arm64; native AlarmManager and UserNotifications APIs
